about: The Workbench icons of the Abuse drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Abuse's own program icon (doc/abuse.png of abuse 0.8). Abuse-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Abuse.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Abuse.info. Each drawer inside data gets a copy of Abuse-drawer.info, which has no place of its own, so Workbench places it.
